maya: wording nit: prefer 'per-token inference cost' and spell out 95th-percentile. Also recommend 'up to' for the cost claim.

clare: updated hero: "Up to 3x lower per-token inference cost and ~50% lower 95th-percentile latency versus our hosted baseline." Adding methodology note and webinar CTA.

"Today were launching Echo  a serving profile that can deliver up to 3x lower per-token inference cost and ~50% lower 95th-percentile latency compared to our hosted baseline. Register to join our live demo on Wed 8/14 at 10am PT and download the benchmark notebook."
